name: Miraval Austin Resort & Spa
insider_take: This wellness sanctuary sits on 220 acres of pristine Texas Hill Country, where ancient live oaks and limestone cliffs create a natural amphitheater for transformation.
whats_special: Miraval Austin is built around a stunning natural amphitheater and features the unique "Challenge Course" - an elevated obstacle course that's both physically and mentally transformative. The resort's signature Life in Balance Spa uses locally-sourced ingredients like Texas wildflower honey and Hill Country limestone in treatments.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise meditation sessions at the Serenity Gazebo - it's positioned perfectly to catch the golden hour light filtering through the ancient oak canopy.
dont_miss: The resort's organic garden-to-table dining experience and the exclusive "Equine Experience" where you'll connect with rescued horses in a peaceful pasture setting. The infinity pool overlooking Onion Creek offers breathtaking Hill Country views, especially at sunset.
pros: World-class spa and wellness programs with mindfulness focus
Stunning Hill Country setting with natural beauty
Exceptional healthy cuisine and farm-to-table dining
